instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Ask a web address for its answer and keep that answer; when the address cannot answer, give back the last answer it gave, so a feed or service that is down does not leave the person with nothing", and give it address (The web address to ask); key (A short name for this answer, so the last good one can be found again).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:ask-a-web-address-or-give-the-last-answer and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give address (a web address that starts with http:// or https://) and key (a short name for this answer: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, so the last answer can be found again); wait_seconds (1 to 120, default 20) is how long to wait for the address.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: kept-answer (records:read, records:write).
